text.en: Clients consistently praise manager Joe, groomer Grace, and the sibling ownership team for their warm and reassuring hospitality. Longtime patrons describe the atmosphere as visiting family, appreciating how staff members answer questions patiently and follow up after stays to check on pets settling back in at home.

Pet parents highlight how comfortable their dogs and cats feel during daycare and boarding, noting that even nervous rescue dogs and elderly pets return home calm and energetic. Reviewers emphasize that animals are handled with genuine affection and respect, giving owners peace of mind while away from home.

title.en: Fresh grooming with mixed cat results

text.en: Dog owners report excellent grooming results, noting fresh coats and happy pets after regular baths and trims. However, cat grooming drew criticism in one instance where an owner felt de-shedding and teeth cleaning were incomplete, leaving loose undercoat behind despite the shop offering a complimentary follow-up touch-up.

q.en: Do they provide boarding updates during a pet stay?

a.en: Yes, clients note that staff frequently sends photos and video clips to reassure owners while their pets are boarded.

q.en: How do dogs behave after boarding here?

a.en: Reviewers report that dogs return home happy, energetic, and calm, showing that they received attentive care and daily exercise.

q.en: Do they groom both dogs and cats?

a.en: Yes, the salon accepts both dogs and cats for bathing and grooming, though cat owners recommend specifying exact de-shedding needs in advance.
